source._what: Mixed. Five questions were AUTHORED for this test (filed into 334437 on 2026-09-02, qsetids 1894925-1894930) because Chapter 0 had no unused multipart items left; the rest are shared-library qsetids already attached to a pushed Chapter 0 homework.

_design: Shares ZERO questions with the Chapter 0 Group Test, by construction. MAP-IM1-GLOBAL.md records that Chapter 1/2/3 ship Review, Group Test and Individual Test as the same questions three times over; this avoids that. Half the items (Q1, Q3, Q5, Q8, Q10) are full multipart processes rather than drills, which is what assessment-presets.json asks an individual test to be -- and which was impossible until the five new questions existed.
_authored: 4 multipart + 1 find-the-mistake written 2026-09-02 under the mom-question skill. The usual render-and-verify against mom.huffpalmer.fyi was NOT available: the school network runs a TLS-inspecting proxy (leaf issued by CN=205.155.196.228) whose root is trusted nowhere on the machine, so both node and Chrome refuse the sandbox. They were verified against the LIVE course instead -- byte-exact read-back on all five fields, then rendered and answered in Teacher Preview, which is the stronger check.

_pushed: Pushed into the Global Question Class 334437 on 2026-09-02, block 0-3-3-1, gradebook category IND (798370), undated, 2 attempts / 1 version / 50% penalty per attempt. Created at the COURSE ROOT as always and moved in with the page's own moveitem(). Five questions were FILED (1894925-1894930, byte-exact read-back on all five fields each); the other 14 are shared-library qsetids attached by GET. READ BACK: 19 questions, 5 groups, 11 points. ANSWERED AND GRADED in Teacher Preview: all five authored questions scored full marks -- Q1 1.02/1, Q3 1.02/1, Q5 1.02/1, Q8 1.02/1, Q10 2.04/2. The numeric parts were answered from MOM's own View Key; every expression part (numfunc/calculated) was worked out from the RENDERED prompt by hand, because View Key does not reveal an expression answer -- so those five are verified against the question as a student sees it, not replayed from the file that generated the key.
_defect_found: Q5 (fraction operations) shipped with a wrong SOLUTION GUIDE and was repaired before the test was finished. The guide claimed all three answers land in lowest terms; the seed constraints only guarantee that for the multiply and the power. Measured live on seed 7/6 and 5/8: the divide gives 56/30, which reduces to 28/15. Forcing all four values pairwise coprime over 2..9 is close to infeasible, so the divide answer is now reduced explicitly with gcd() and the guide shows the reduction as a step. qsetid 1894927 was UPDATED in place, not re-filed. Byte-exactness and a clean render both passed this question before the defect was seen; only reading the rendered arithmetic caught it.
